pre_mortem: It's Monday and both legs lost. Skattebo finished under 53.5 because Thomas and Eluemunor both sat, the Saints stuffed a backup-tackle run game, Harris took the usable carries the way he did in the 52-yard week, and NYG trailed early so the 36-rush script and a quiet receiving day landed together — the week he only cleared by 1.5 yards (55) is how a slightly worse version loses at -113. Johnson lost because Olave played a full route tree (31 targets over the last three games), the Giants' 9.52 middle YPA was 21-attempt noise and they did not blitz near 40%, Shough held the ball instead of checking down, and the 16-yard game — not the 66/53/59 cluster — was the one that repeated. A 42.7-yard recent average against 40.5 had no cushion once the funnel did not show up.
